scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: npm run build --prefix client && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,green "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run preview --prefix client -- --host 0.0.0.0 --port 5173"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && npm run lint --prefix client
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client -- --run
